description: This file contains implementation of process functions for handling various HTTP requests (Notify, Search, MSearch, MPost, Subscribe, Unsubscribe) within a Web Service Plane component for Broadway Web Service System. It includes logic to either invoke external handlers or reply with standard 405 Method Not Allowed responses, and references multiple HTTP request/response and method handling functions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwspWsoDoNotify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Handles a web request message to notify/announce. Invokes external DoNotify handler if available; otherwise, constructs an Allow header response with permitted methods.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwspWsoDoSearch(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Processes a search request. Delegates to external DoSearch or responds with a 405 Method Not Allowed with appropriate allow methods.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwspWsoDoMSearch(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Handles a multicast search request similarly to BwspWsoDoSearch.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwspWsoDoMPost(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Processes a multicast post request, delegating or returning a method not allowed response.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwspWsoDoSubscribe(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, delegating or responding with method not allowed.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwspWsoDoUnsubscribe(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Handles unsubscription requests, delegating or returning method not allowed.
